name: resume-roaster
description: AI Resume Brutal Roaster — root scripts (backend + frontend)

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
scripts.setup: npm install && npm install --prefix frontend && cd backend && python -m poetry install
scripts.check: npm run check --prefix backend && npm run lint --prefix frontend && npm run build --prefix frontend
scripts.check:frontend: npm run lint --prefix frontend && npm run build --prefix frontend
